risks.risk: Console may not be PS4 Pro (could be another PS4 model) because model/label is not readable in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console model/serial label (rear/bottom sticker) showing the exact PS4 model code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used PS4 console bundle with 1 controller not confirmed as Pro.

risks.risk: Controller and cables may be missing or not original (seller claims original pads/receipt, but none are shown).
risks.proof: Clear photos of the controller(s) and all included cables/adapters laid out (power, HDMI, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (or console + controller not confirmed), worst-case for missing accessories.

risks.risk: Functionality risk: ports, HDMI, disc drive, and general operation may fail (seller claims all ports work, no overheating).
risks.proof: Short video showing boot to home screen + HDMI output + at least one port test (USB/charging) and a brief game load.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified working (worst-case: treat as needing testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Receipt/UK origin may be untrue or not included (seller claims UK receipt).
risks.proof: Photo of the receipt document (with sensitive details covered) or a clear scan.

proof_requests: Close-up of the console’s model/serial label (rear/bottom sticker) to confirm it is PS4 Pro and the exact model code.
Photos of the included controller(s) and all accessories laid out (controller, power cable, HDMI, etc.).
Video proof: power on → home screen → controller pairing → brief game/app launch.
Port check close-ups (USB/HDMI/Ethernet) and/or a short clip plugging in and using them.
response.reason: The photos do not clearly confirm the item as a PS4 Pro, nor do they show the controller or included accessories/receipt. Without decisive proof, a worst-case price cannot be reliably matched to the correct console type.
